name: Tabs, sheet music and lyrics

delText: The file will disappear from this device.
uploadHint: Supported: PDF (sheet music and tabs), Guitar Pro (gp3–gp5, gpx, gp), MusicXML (.xml, .mxl), Capella and text tabs (.txt).

notSaved: The file won’t be kept after reload
about: Guitar Pro tabs and lyrics with chords
tr.fromChords: Original key: {k}, detected from the chords. For accuracy, set it in the song card.
tr.hint: Chords keep their scale degrees, and accidentals (sharps or flats) follow the new key: F♯ and C♯ in D major, B♭ in F major.
deg.title: Chord view
deg.hint: Scale degrees do not depend on the key: I is the tonic, IV the subdominant, V the dominant; major in capitals, minor in lower case (vi), ° diminished, ø half-diminished. The Nashville system writes the same with numbers: 1, 4, 5, 6m. Lyrics can also be written in degrees — [I], [vi7], 1 4 5 1 — and are then shown as chords in the chosen key.
tr.fromAssumed: The text is written in scale degrees and no key is set — showing {k}. The key can be set in the song card or chosen here.
help.what: Tabs, PDF scores and lyrics with chords.
help.1: Guitar Pro, MusicXML, Capella and text (ASCII) tabs — with playback; the format is detected from the content.
help.2: PDF — pinch to zoom; opens on the last page.
help.tip: Transpose to fit the voice or a capo.
pdf.pwText: A password is required. It is stored only on this device.
pdf.err.broken: The PDF is damaged or incomplete
pdf.err.reupload: If the file opens in other apps — delete it here (−) and upload it again
pdf.err.read: The file cannot be read. Save it to the phone storage and upload it again
lib.title: Lyrics and chords
lib.empty: No lyrics yet: add them to a song or drop a .cho/.txt file into the Melete → Lyrics folder.
dawEmpty: .mid files and DAW projects — Ableton (.als), Reaper (.rpp), FL Studio (.flp) — open as a score. “To Studio” — edit in the app.
help.4: MIDI & DAW: .mid files and Ableton, Reaper, FL Studio projects — as a score; “To Studio” — edit.
openFailFmt: Could not open the file ({fmt}). Supported: Guitar Pro 3–8, MusicXML, Capella, PDF and text tabs
pasteHint: String lines from a website or a message: e|--3--5--|… Frets, chords, h/p, slides and bars are recognised; rhythm — by the spacing between notes. Playback as with any tab.
capo.title: Capo
capo.hint: Capo on fret {n}: sounds in {k}, chords shown as {k2} shapes. Hold the button to remove the capo.
capo.hint0: Capo on fret N: the key stays the same, chords are shown as shapes N semitones lower.
